We make big, bold printable coloring & activity books for little hands (ages 2–6). Easy to color, fun to learn.

Follow along for new books, coloring fun and tips for parents!

{cta}

#coloringbook #kidsactivities #preschoolactivities #toddleractivities #coloringpages #homeschool

Why coloring is so good for little learners ✏️
1. Builds pencil grip & hand strength
2. Practices focus and patience
3. Teaches colors, shapes & letters
4. Calms busy minds before bedtime
5. Sparks creativity and pride!

Save this for later 💛

{cta}

#coloringbook #kidsactivities #preschoolactivities #toddleractivities #coloringpages #homeschool #prekactivities #learningthroughplay #kindergartenprep #earlylearning

3 coloring tips for toddlers 🖍️
1. Go big & simple: chunky crayons + big pictures
2. Keep it short: 5–10 minutes is plenty
3. Praise the effort, not the lines!

Save this for your next coloring time 💛

{cta}
